player_prompt.intro:
Káma kaŋ Bìrì {player_id} a cikin {num_rounds}-zàga na IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
A kowacce zagaye, ka tsinci lamba tsakanin {min_guess} da {max_guess}.
Bayan ka tsinci duka biyu, burin shine (2/3)x(matsakaicin duka tsinci biyu),
ka wanda tsincinsa ya fi kusa da burin ya ci zagayen.
Amsa da tsincinka a cikin tsari '[<number>]'.
